Agent 30/35 — off-track recovery/re-entry. Simulate a wheel pair or full car entering runoff/gravel and rejoining asphalt at 40–100 km/h while steering. Audit surface transitions, tire slip, countersteer gating and sudden grip restoration for snap or impossible yaw impulses. Do not make gravel unrealistically forgiving. Fix only discontinuities/state bugs and add mirrored re-entry tests.
